description: This Java source file defines the ImageDownloader class, which handles asynchronous downloading and caching of images from the internet for use in Android ImageView components. It includes internal cache management, download task handling, and cache clearing mechanisms.

classes.name: ImageDownloader
classes.description: Helper class for downloading images asynchronously, with internal caching and cache management.

classes.name: BitmapDownloaderTask
classes.description: AsyncTask subclass that handles background image download and caching.

classes.name: DownloadedDrawable
classes.description: Drawable used as a placeholder during image download, holding a reference to the download task.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads an image from a URL and binds it to an ImageView, using cache if available.

methods.name: download (overload)
methods.description: Downloads an image with an optional cookie parameter.

methods.name: forceDownload
methods.description: Forces download of an image, bypassing cache, and binds it to an ImageView.

methods.name: cancelPotentialDownload
methods.description: Cancels ongoing download for an ImageView if it does not match the requested URL.

methods.name: getBitmapDownloaderTask
methods.description: Retrieves the current download task associated with an ImageView.

methods.name: getBitmapFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves a bitmap from cache if available.

methods.name: doInBackground
methods.description: Performs the image download in background thread.

methods.name: onPostExecute
methods.description: Binds the downloaded bitmap to the ImageView after download completes.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data from InputStream to OutputStream.

methods.name: getBitmapDownloaderTask (in DownloadedDrawable)
methods.description: Returns the download task associated with this drawable.
